coaching.headline: Nine of us died alone outside any fight — that fed Greystone to 14/3, and we won exactly one fight all game.
coaching.team: The caught-out column is the whole loss: nine solo deaths (four on our offlaner, three on mid, plus Sparrow at 14.5 and Aurora at 17.4) against an enemy that lost only two, feeding a Greystone-Wraith-Skylar triangle that ended 39 kills between them. We won one fight in 36 minutes and cashed nothing; they won ten and cashed four, and the objective-damage gap was 3.7k to 85.7k. The fix is boring and total: move in pairs, ward before crossing river, and stop taking 1v1s against a fed jungler.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The solo-death drip (nine caught-out deaths) plus the 24.5 fight — 3-6 at their inhibitor that cost Primal Fangtooth and the inhibitor in the same window.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Sparrow's 8 kills led our board, but the 14.5 solo catch by Wraith priced out at Fangtooth 15.1 plus a tower at 15.8, and the macro flags Sparrow alive and never joining at 19.9 and at the 35.6 Orb fight — the last two fights that could have flipped the endgame. On a bleeding map, the fed carry either arrives or the fight shouldn't happen.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Aurora went 2/8 into a Greystone who finished 14/3 — the jungle read flipped against us by mid-game and stayed there. The deaths worth studying are the chosen ones: the 19.9 bad trade deep in our half and the 32.3 fight lost 1-3 with a man advantage — the fight selection was the leak.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,265 hero damage a minute, more than 88% of Skylar carry players this patch (25% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Solaris, Tainted Rounds.
Atomiser at rank 3: 85s base, about 77.3s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Solaris 10.
Skylar dealt 45,552 hero damage, 25% of their team's, with +302 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Steel (level 17: about 209 physical armor, 197 after penetration; took 34,657 physical damage from heroes, 69% of all hero damage they took) and Sparrow (level 16: about 96 physical armor, 84 after penetration; took 14,524 physical damage from heroes, 83% of all hero damage they took) that is about 4% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Solaris (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Solaris: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 3,954 healing recorded.

(game text: Air Assault hovers for 0.5s longer and fires an additional missile with each attack.) (changes Air Assault, 14.5s cooldown with their haste) Field: 48% in 2776 games, 67% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.1%.

Loadout Eternal Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero deals bonus damage based on their max health. Skylar attacks fast, so it triggers often against tanks. (game text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 44.4% in 995 games, 24% of picks, below the hero-role's 47.1%.

Loadout minor Serration: Vermis's third-hit bonus also deals damage based on missing health, finishing wounded targets faster. (game text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 44.2% in 981 games, 99% of picks, below the hero-role's 47.1%.

Loadout minor Melting Point: More damage to targets with lots of armor. A pick into tanky teams; Hypercharge already ignores some armor. (game text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.) Field: 44.7% in 929 games, 93% of picks, below the hero-role's 47.1%.

Loadout crest Liberator: Removes crowd control and other debuffs and gives a shield. Save it for the stun or slow that would let divers kill you. (game text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.) Field: 46.5% in 1950 games, 47% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.1%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Plasma Blade, Lightning Hawk, Solaris, Tainted Rounds, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Solaris, Liberator.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 3 of the 5 players Skylar killed built physical armor (Steel, Aurora, Khaimera). Anti-heal on Steel, The Fey, Aurora. We killed Skylar 4 times.
Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 44.4% in 919 Skylar carry games, below the hero's 47.1%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
